content: Lifestyle modifications that can help prevent or alleviate constipation include engaging in regular physical activity, staying adequately hydrated by drinking sufficient water, and consuming a balanced diet rich in fiber. Foods such as bran, fresh fruits, and vegetables are particularly beneficial. If you miss a dose of your medication, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is close to the time of your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to make up for the missed one. Different brands of this medication may have specific storage requirements. Always refer to the product packaging for storage instructions or consult your pharmacist. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless explicitly instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information was last updated in May 2024. Common side effects of this medication may include gas or stomach cramping. If your doctor has prescribed this product, it is because they have determined that the benefits outweigh the potential risks. This medication must be taken with at least a full glass of water or another liquid (8 ounces or 240 milliliters) to prevent it from swelling in the throat, which could cause choking. Severe allergic reactions to this medication are rare. However, this is not an exhaustive list of possible side effects. Before using this bulk-forming laxative, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it or have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other issues. Some formulations may include sugar or aspartame, so caution is advised if you have diabetes, phenylketonuria (PKU), or any condition requiring you to limit or avoid these substances in your diet. In the event of an overdose, if the individual has severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away.
